name: QEMU linux-user: default 4 GiB contiguous guest reservation for a 32-bit target on a 64-bit host (reserved_va = MAX_RESERVED_VA = 0xffffffff)
component: qemu-i386 / qemu-arm linux-user: pgb_addr_set + pgb_try_mmap (HOST_LONG_BITS==64 && TARGET_VIRT_ADDR_SPACE_BITS<=32)
required_postconditions: the reservation is one contiguous range [guest_base + 0, guest_base + reserved_va] with reserved_va == 0xffffffff
guest_base is aligned to MAX(SHMLBA, TARGET_PAGE_SIZE), asserted after selection
no host object may be placed inside the reservation for the life of the process
the reservation is PROT_NONE and MAP_NORESERVE: address space only, no committed memory

failure_sink.description: when no guest_base satisfies every bound, pgb_dynamic prints 'Unable to find a guest_base to satisfy all guest address mapping requirements', lists the bounds and calls exit(EXIT_FAILURE). The -B (fixed guest_base) path fails earlier via pgb_fail_in_use at line 164, also exit(EXIT_FAILURE).

source_locations.symbol: reserved_va = max_reserved_va, taken when HOST_LONG_BITS==64 && TARGET_VIRT_ADDR_SPACE_BITS<=32
if ((reserved_va + 1) % host_page_size) -> 'Reserved virtual address not aligned' + exit
pgb_addr_set: ga->bounds[n].hi = reserved_va (one bound covering the whole guest space)
uintptr_t align = MAX(SHMLBA, TARGET_PAGE_SIZE); asserted at line 344

extraction_limitations: required_alignment 4096 is MAX(SHMLBA, TARGET_PAGE_SIZE) evaluated for an x86-64 Linux host, where SHMLBA == PAGE_SIZE == 4096. On MIPS hosts SHMLBA is larger and the constant changes; the source does not name a literal.
'the reservation must be contiguous' is a postcondition of the code but is not expressible as a field in this schema; it is carried as free text only.
the 30-retry probe loop in pgb_find_itree/pgb_find_fallback is a search over guest_base, not a retry of the same request, so max_retries is left unset.

x_campaign.rationale: A 4 GiB PROT_NONE MAP_NORESERVE reservation is routine on x86-64 Linux, whose user address space is ~128 TiB; QEMU also permits relocation via guest_base, so no exact address is needed.
x_campaign.note_after_schema_fix: QEMU maps over its PROT_NONE reservation and checks THAT call; it is not the Windows two-phase model.
